about: Model-free red-flag screen, run on every participant line before the Clef flag is used. Patterns match lowercased text with accents removed (NFD, combining marks stripped), so they are plain ASCII. A hit sets the red flag of that kind whatever the model says. Written from clinical screening wording (C-SSRS style ideation, emergency warning signs) in English, Spanish and Haitian Creole; tuned only on the dev split and the first stress set, never on validation or stress-set-v2.
